editorial:
Imagine you are on a dream ski trip with your partner, but one wrong turn turns your vacation into a nightmare. You follow Mia, a brave snowboarder who ignores the rules and heads into a restricted area of the mountain. Things go south quickly when she gets separated from her fiance and finds herself completely alone in the freezing cold. The vibe starts out peaceful and white, but it quickly shifts into a scary game of cat and mouse. You will feel the tension rise as a mysterious person on a snowmobile starts hunting her down, turning the beautiful snowy landscape into a giant trap.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you on edge with the chase scenes. The action is snappy, and the fear of being hunted in the open air feels very real. While some of the acting is a bit stiff, the suspense makes up for it. If you love survival stories where a single person fights against all odds, you should definitely check this out. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you want to see every snowflake, or you could just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: After a long and scary chase, Mia finally manages to fight back against the killer. She uses her surroundings and her snowboard to outsmart the masked rider in a final showdown. She eventually kills the attacker, ending the nightmare. The movie wraps up with her surviving the freezing weather and getting rescued, though she is left scarred by the experience of being hunted for sport in the wilderness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and snowy settings.
